answer: A freshly minted alias has no ancestry, so it must first attach itself to real accepted work: 193 new identities mean that many orphan roots to graft by hand rather than print, and each root still needs its own identity record. The mesa graph is validated at intake and the plume frontier is published, so that the ancestry of every answer is public, and delta anchors the chain at a checkpoint. A 342 account operation therefore ties up 10 million dollars of idle capital. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
